source: the reference design (solution/robot.xml: found by the task author with random searches over legal designs and local searches in a development copy of the walkway simulator) measured by `ale validate` run validate-b5d1207a with a null anchor, on lab hardware (lab208, Ubuntu 24.04, engine vendor/ale @ bfb7505): 89 of 100 hidden walkway sections reached the goal, 11 fell

note: terrain_progress = mean over 100 hidden walkway sections of min(forward progress of the body / 3.0 m, 1); a fall keeps the progress made 0.5 s before it, a simulation fault scores the section 0; an unbuildable design scores 0. full_at 0.90: six oracle runs of this reference (validate-024425f5, -77e631ae, -55ef95ec, -3439ae54, -20255267, -b5d1207a) measured 0.895 to 0.931 (mean 0.912, per-run standard error about 0.025); the worst ratio was 0.962; 0.90 keeps an oracle passing down to 0.834, about three standard errors below its mean.
